baseline_config_lock_gate.threshold: only authorized Raman paths differ from Phase 6 production baseline
baseline_config_lock_gate.production_impact: prevents accidental grid, ionization, beam, or safety changes
baseline_config_lock_gate.required_action: restore the Phase 6 baseline and regenerate the config diff

on_off_single_factor_gate.production_impact: makes Job 2 a valid single-factor control
on_off_single_factor_gate.required_action: remove every additional ON/OFF config difference

explicit_operator_switch_gate.threshold: full mode uses the explicit full-operator feedback switch
explicit_operator_switch_gate.physical_impact: distinguishes complex Eq.27 feedback from legacy Raman phase

legacy_absorption_rejection_gate.threshold: all legacy phase/absorption combinations rejected in full mode
legacy_absorption_rejection_gate.production_impact: legacy alpha_R and conv_deriv remain disabled

full_operator_diagnostic_wiring_gate.threshold: ON applies the operator; OFF preserves raw diagnostics without field feedback
full_operator_diagnostic_wiring_gate.physical_impact: makes raw response and applied complex feedback separately observable
full_operator_diagnostic_wiring_gate.required_action: repair production diagnostic wiring before a full job

raman_energy_accounting_gate.threshold: finite accounting and cumulative target/actual mismatch <0.5%; legacy alpha_R=0
raman_energy_accounting_gate.physical_impact: tracks Eq.10 target against actual Raman field energy exchange
raman_energy_accounting_gate.production_impact: blocks propagation on missing or duplicated Raman energy

convolution_reuse_gate.threshold: 2 convolutions per Heun operator application; no duplicate Eq.10 convolution
convolution_reuse_gate.physical_impact: preserves stage-consistent I_R and Eq.10 diagnostics
convolution_reuse_gate.production_impact: controls full-job runtime and duplicate work
convolution_reuse_gate.required_action: reuse each stage response for RHS and energy diagnostics

combined_split_convergence_gate.physical_impact: verifies convergence of Raman/non-Raman Strang composition
combined_split_convergence_gate.production_impact: selects the admissible combined nonlinear ordering
combined_split_convergence_gate.required_action: repair or refine the combined nonlinear split

combined_split_production_step_gate.threshold: production dz vs two dz/2 references within field/I/rho/Raman limits
combined_split_production_step_gate.physical_impact: bounds operator-order bias at production dz
combined_split_production_step_gate.required_action: reduce dz or repair the combined split

full_size_smoke_gate.threshold: serial 20-step ON/OFF full-grid smokes complete without NaN/Inf
full_size_smoke_gate.physical_impact: tests the real full grid and production call chain
full_size_smoke_gate.production_impact: blocks full submission on OOM or numerical failure

memory_gate.physical_impact: keeps GPU allocation below the safety ceiling
memory_gate.required_action: optimize memory reuse without reducing the production grid

runtime_gate.physical_impact: ensures the full run fits its allocation
runtime_gate.production_impact: prevents submitting a job likely to time out
runtime_gate.required_action: optimize convolution reuse or request a justified time limit

expected_diagnostic_contract_gate.threshold: all required production diagnostics, units, coordinates, and energy thresholds recorded
expected_diagnostic_contract_gate.physical_impact: defines acceptance of completed full propagation
expected_diagnostic_contract_gate.required_action: repair and regenerate the diagnostic contract

full_job_submission_gate.evidence: aggregate Phase 8B-P gates and complete local pytest
full_job_submission_gate.threshold: all preflight gates passed and complete local pytest has zero failures
full_job_submission_gate.physical_impact: controls whether full 1.3 m propagation may be separately authorized
full_job_submission_gate.production_impact: authorizes preparation of Phase 8B-R only after a new user approval
full_job_submission_gate.required_action: resolve every failed or inconclusive gate; then request explicit Phase 8B-R approval
